orchestrator_adjudication: Headline 'prod-guard bypass via forged guardConfig' DOWNGRADED high->medium: verified sn-rest.classifyInstance trusts passed subProdPatterns and mainworld.ts checks only event.source===window; but any script that can forge the message already runs in page MAIN world with session cookie + window.g_ck and can hit REST directly, so no privilege escalation — defense-in-depth only. Guard's real purpose (protect user from own accidental prod write) intact.

findings.description: Field regex has no CDATA awareness. SN unload wraps script/HTML fields in <![CDATA[...]]>. If CDATA content contains a substring resembling a closing tag (e.g. script builds '</script>' or '</foo>'), the non-greedy match terminates early, truncating the field and desyncing every subsequent match in the exec loop for that record (and whole multi-record scan). Pasting a BR whose script contains '</script>' corrupts parsed fields.
findings.suggested_fix: Strip/handle CDATA blocks explicitly before tag-matching, or use DOMParser in the side-panel context where it runs.

findings.description: {status:'running'} written with no timestamp/run-id. If SW is killed mid-fetch (update, suspend, memory eviction), final setJob never runs and storage.session holds 'running' permanently. Panel restores from storage and shows 'still reviewing...' forever with no retry path.
findings.suggested_fix: Store startedAt; panel/alarms treat running older than fetch timeout+margin as stale -> allow retry.

findings.description: Both postMessage bridges validate only event.source===window, never event.origin. Any script in the shared page context can forge sncat:g_form/sncat:fetch/sncat:fetch-result. No leak beyond what page already has, but removes defense-in-depth.
findings.suggested_fix: Add event.origin===location.origin and validate data.kind shape/allowlist in both listeners.

findings.description: guardConfig carried on the forgeable sncat:fetch channel and passed unre-validated to executeApiRequest. VERIFIED: classifyInstance trusts subProdPatterns; {subProdPatterns:['.']} allows any non-'prod'-labeled host incl. many real production names. DOWNGRADED to medium (see adjudication): forging script already has full page session access, no escalation.
findings.suggested_fix: Re-derive sub-prod decision inside trusted boundary (content script/REST executor reading storage.local or location.host) rather than trusting the channel value.

findings.description: g_ck written to chrome.storage.session (gck:<host>) on every snapshot; no reviewed consumer reads it back (fetch re-reads window.g_ck live in mainworld:74). Needless retention of a live credential, readable from any extension context.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep g_ck in-memory only, or confirm the out-of-scope consumer (api-client) and TTL/document it; remove if dead.

findings.description: sys_scope/sys_package absent from both strip lists despite the same cross-instance-breakage rationale documented for sys_domain/sys_class_name. Importing a scoped record verbatim can fail or silently land in an unrelated app on the target. Note: buildPlanPrompt (llm.ts:239) already tells the LLM never to set sys_scope/sys_package — F3 import doesn't apply its own rule.
findings.suggested_fix: Add sys_scope, sys_package (and likely sys_update_name) to SYSTEM_FIELDS.

findings.description: Fallback uses candidate.lastIndexOf('}'); if the model appends any trailing text containing '}', the slice is invalid JSON and JSON.parse throws 'Model did not return valid JSON' even though a valid object was present earlier.
findings.suggested_fix: Depth-aware brace scan (string/escape-aware) from first '{' to its true matching '}'.

findings.description: No locking on jobKey(tabId,op). Double-clicked Review / panel retry -> two 'running' writes racing to the same key; a stale earlier fetch finishing after a fresh retry silently overwrites the newer result.
findings.suggested_fix: In-memory Set/Map of in-flight jobKeys; reject/coalesce duplicates.

findings.description: setJob swallows all storage.session.set failures; no tabs.onRemoved cleanup. Entries (with full script bodies) accumulate unbounded toward ~10MB quota; if the final write fails under quota pressure the job sticks at 'running'.
findings.suggested_fix: Purge llmJob:<tabId>:* on tabs.onRemoved; at least console.error a failed final write.

findings.description: onMessage listeners don't check sender.id/sender.tab. Not exploitable today (no externally_connectable; Chrome scopes runtime messaging to same extension) but latent if externally_connectable is ever added.
findings.suggested_fix: Assert sender.id===chrome.runtime.id (and sender.tab where relevant) at each listener top.

findings.description: API key plaintext in storage.local; endpoint fully user-configurable with optional_host_permissions https://*/*; no endpoint allowlist and no redaction of script content before send (handoff §2 dec.4 requires redaction). A typo'd/tampered endpoint silently exfiltrates script content.
findings.suggested_fix: Warn/confirm when endpoint not on known-good allowlist; implement redaction before broad ship.

findings.description: Self-closing empty field (<short_description/>) doesn't match the pair regex and is silently dropped; 'explicitly cleared' vs 'never present' becomes indistinguishable for F3 copy.
findings.suggested_fix: Add self-closing alternative recording empty string.

findings.description: Route marker chosen via lastIndexOf; a URL with >1 'record'/'list' segment anchors on the last, which may not be followed by a valid table/sysId -> null -> 'unknown' classification despite an earlier valid route.
findings.suggested_fix: Prefer first occurrence followed by a valid table/sysId pair.

findings.description: Outer block regex breaks if an attribute value contains literal '>'. SN's action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE" is simple and unaffected; latent fragility.
findings.suggested_fix: Low priority; noted if block logic extended.

findings.description: No max-input guard before regex scan; handoff §9 flags a 50-record cap as open. A huge pasted list export runs synchronously -> UI freeze.
findings.suggested_fix: Max-input-length guard with user-facing error at the shared parsing entry point.

findings.description: Field-extraction loop duplicated verbatim across parseUnloadXml/All; raises risk of applying the CDATA fix to only one copy.

purpose_notes_condensed: extractJson: recovers JSON from fenced/prose-wrapped LLM replies (providers ignore 'only JSON').
seedInstruction: picks tester-script current/previous seeding wording per UI seed mode.
coerceResult/coercePlan: normalize untyped LLM JSON to strict shape, degrade to blanks not crash.
callAgentHub: adapter for MFEC internal gateway (concatenated prompt, Bearer, {response}).
unescapeXml: unescapes & LAST so double-escaped values round-trip.
dedupeRecords: collapse duplicate blocks from DEEP unload (multi-path reachability).
importableFields/COPY_DROP_FIELDS: strip audit/identity fields + 'number' so a copy isn't a dup.
resolveContext: URL parse wins; g_form fills gaps (classic forms w/o sys_id in URL).
runLlmJob/jobKey: run in SW so in-flight fetch keeps SW alive; per-(tabId,op) storage.session for recovery.
post()/setTimeout(post,800): re-post g_form snapshot because classic forms init g_form late; no ready hook.

unclear_code.note: RESOLVED by orchestrator: sn-rest DOES trust passed guardConfig; host for classifyInstance is the write host. See adjudication.
Whether ApiRequest restricts to fixed Table API paths/methods or allows arbitrary URL affects forged-message reach; 'text' op (per T-101) takes a caller-supplied URL.
No in-scope consumer reads gck:<host> back; possibly consumed by api-client (out of scope) or dead.
